item.title: Lola Young, Elton John, Rosalía & More Honored at 2026 Ivor Novello Awards: Complete Winners List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard. I'm your host, and today we're celebrating the best in songwriting at the 2026 Ivor Novello Awards. The prestigious ceremony took place in London, where music legends and rising stars gathered to honor outstanding achievements in songwriting."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Ivor Novello Awards, often referred to as the 'Oscars equivalent' for songwriters, have been recognizing greatness since 1956. Previous winners include iconic names like Paul McCartney, David Bowie, and Adele. This year's ceremony saw a number of honorary awards handed out, including the international songwriter award, which went to Linda Perry, presented by James Blunt."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Rosalía made history as the inaugural winner of the international songwriter of the year prize. Sam Fender collected the songwriter of the year award from the one and only Elton John, who was also honored as the first-ever president of The Ivor's Academy. And, in a touching moment, George Michael posthumously received the Fellowship of the Academy prize, with his WHAM! bandmate Andrew Ridgeley accepting on his behalf."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Other notable winners included Thom Yorke, who received a fellowship prize from Harry Styles, and Lily Allen, who earned the outstanding song collection prize. Calvin Harris took home the icon award, while Kano received the visionary award. And, in the nominated categories, CMAT triumphed in the best album category with their third album, 'EURO-Country'."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Congratulations to all the winners at the 2026 Ivor Novello Awards. We'll be back with more music news and updates soon."
